compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: LMV321IDBVR assigns 1IN+ (IN_POS) whereas TLV3201AIDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: LMV321IDBVR assigns 1IN- (IN_NEG) whereas TLV3201AIDBVR assigns IN+ (IN_POS) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: LMV321IDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) whereas TLV3201AIDBVR assigns IN- (IN_NEG) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VCC pin (VCC+ vs VCC).

parameter_matrix.note: Op-amps (internally compensated for linear feedback) and comparators (uncompensated open-loop switching) are NOT drop-in interchangeable.
Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.
A part wins only if its recommended Vs range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Exceeding Vs,abs causes immediate gate-oxide or junction breakdown.
Closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth scales as f_-3dB = GBWP / Acl.
Controls large-signal full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak) or comparator switching speed.
Lower Vos minimizes DC error in current-shunt and sensor bridge amplifiers.
CMOS/JFET pA-class inputs avoid offset voltage drops across high-impedance (>100 kΩ) sensors.
Multiply by channel count for total IC standby current draw.
RRIO prevents clipping on low-voltage 3.3 V single-supply ADC buffers.
Winner requires superiority on both CMRR (higher) and input voltage noise (lower); mixed tradeoffs stay CONTEXT.
Important when driving heavy resistive loads or high supply rails.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS) in addition to the op-amp vs comparator class conflict.

CRITICAL OP-AMP VS COMPARATOR TRAP: LMV321IDBVR is a opamp with push-pull output while TLV3201AIDBVR is a comparator with push-pull output. Even with identical pinouts, a comparator is an uncompensated switching device: dropping it into a linear negative-feedback op-amp circuit (buffer, gain stage, filter) causes oscillation or latch-up, and an op-amp used as a comparator suffers slow overdrive/saturation recovery. Both outputs are push-pull (no external pull-up required) — the incompatibility is loop compensation and switching behavior, not pull-up drive.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LMV321IDBVR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=RR vs TLV3201AIDBVR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 15000x (LMV321IDBVR: 15000 pA p.7 vs TLV3201AIDBVR: 1 pA p.5); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 3.3x (LMV321IDBVR: 130 µA/ch p.7 vs TLV3201AIDBVR: 40 µA/ch p.5); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: LMV321IDBVR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (5.5 V, p.5) than TLV3201AIDBVR (7 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 5.5 V.
engineering_verdict: LMV321IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV3201AIDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS); device kind mismatch (opamp/push-pull vs comparator/push-pull) — circuit redesign required. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Signal-chain deltas: opamp (push-pull) vs comparator (push-pull), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.4), Vos 7 mV (p.7) vs 3 mV (p.5), Ib 15000x gap (15000 vs 1 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LMV321IDBVR "CRITICAL SOT-23-5 Pinout Mismatch vs TLV9001IDBVR, TLV9061IDBVR, OPA333AIDBVR, and TLV3201AIDBVR" (p.3) and TLV3201AIDBVR "Push-Pull Output — Do NOT Wired-AND or Pull Up to a Different Logic Rail" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose LMV321IDBVR when the circuit is a linear closed-loop amplifier, buffer, or active filter; choose TLV3201AIDBVR when the circuit is an open-loop threshold/window comparator (push-pull output) or DC precision demands <= 3 mV max Vos. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
